title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Travel Agencies Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Travel Agencies Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

AN
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa travel Agencies
(Amendment) Act, 2013
AN
ACT
to
amend the Travel Agencies
Act, 1976.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Travel Agencies Act, 1976
(Act No. XXX of 1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Travel Agencies
(Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province
of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

(i) after the existing clause (a),

(aa) Government means the
Government of the Khyber pakhtunkhwa; ;

(iii) for clause (g), the

(g) tourist means a person normally residing
outside the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and FATA or is a citizen of other country who validly enters the Province of the

as touring, recreation, sports, health study or religious pilgrimages. .

It is hereby

8. Amendment of section 14 of Act No. XXX of 1976.---In the said Act,
in section 14, for sub-section (1), the following shall be substituted,
namely:
(1) Any travel agency, which contravenes or fails
to comply with the provisions of this
Act or the rules or violates the prescribed code of conduct shall, without prejudice to any other action that may
be taken against it under this Act, be punishable, for the first
offence, with fine which may extend to fifty
thousand rupees and for subsequent offence the Controller may seal the
Travel Agency:
Provided that
any person, who willfully obstructs, hinders, resists or in any way opposes the Controller or other official subordinate to
him, in performing their duties under
this section, shall be punishable with fine which may extend to fifty
thousand rupees or with imprisonment for a
term which may extend to three months or both. .

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Travel Agencies Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 15A in Act No. XXX of 1976

AN
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa travel Agencies
(Amendment) Act, 2013
AN
ACT
to
amend the Travel Agencies
Act, 1976.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Travel Agencies Act, 1976
(Act No. XXX of 1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
10. Insertion of new section 15A in Act No. XXX of 1976.--- In the said Act, after section 15 so substituted, the following new section 15A shall
be inserted, namely:
15A. Issuance of ticket.--- A licensed travel agency shall obtain a passport of traveler for issuance of air ticket
and confirmation of seats from
airlines and therefore can hold the passport of passenger for organizing group tours for citizens of Pakistan
to a foreign country or countries. .
